visual_prompt: A live graph of network nodes. When an anomaly is detected, the agent visually quarantines the infected red node by slicing its connection lines and wrapping it in an amber shield.
A pipeline graphic illustrating how SIEM alerts are filtered, enriched, and classified by the SOC Agent.
A timeline comparison showing MTTR (Mean Time To Respond) with and without the autonomous agent.
A circular radar screen with animated sweeping beam, floating threat alert badges (🚨 Ransomware, 👾 Malware, 🔒 Host Isolated, 📡 Exfiltration), and interactive threat mitigation controls.
